base.alt: Concept image: a bright, empty bathroom during a remodel, with dated walls and the old fixtures gone, before any design work.

baseVariants.prompt: A realistic photograph of an EMPTY bathroom being remodelled, with the old fixtures removed in an ordinary 1990s to 2010s Midwest American suburban house, not a loft and not luxury. Bright, open and airy: big windows, lots of soft daylight, light floors. A frosted window, a light porcelain tile floor, capped plumbing only, plain thin builder baseboards. Eye-level camera standing in a corner. One large, plain, completely clear main wall is fully visible and unobstructed. Nothing hangs on the walls. No people, no plants, no text, no logos. Natural colour, gentle shadows, 4:3 photograph. The walls are painted a dated 1990s pinkish beige that looks a little dingy.

editInstruction: Keep EVERYTHING that already exists exactly as it is: the same camera position, lens, framing, walls, wall colour, trim, window, floor, light and furniture. Keep the lighting and exposure identical: do not darken, re-light or add shadows to the walls, floor or ceiling beyond a soft contact shadow directly under the new item. Do not crop, zoom, re-light or restyle. Only make this change:

stages.caption: Beadboard on the lower walls first: it is practical in a bathroom and it says cottage straight away.
A deep freestanding tub under the window and a washed oak vanity.
A round rattan mirror, with a sconce on each side so the light is kind in the morning.
Striped towels on a wooden ladder, close to the tub.
A seagrass basket, a small plant and a jar of shells from somewhere you liked.

final.alt: Concept image: the finished seaside bathroom with beadboard, a freestanding tub, a washed oak vanity, a rattan mirror, sconces and striped towels.
